entry.title: Siemens CPCI85 Central Processing Communication out-of-bounds write
entry.summary: A vulnerability was found in Siemens CPCI85 Central Processing Communication and SICORE Base system (the affected version unknown). It has been rated as critical. Affected by this issue is an unknown part. Upgrading eliminates this vulnerability.

details.affected: A vulnerability was found in Siemens CPCI85 Central Processing Communication and SICORE Base system (the affected version unknown). It has been rated as critical.
details.vulnerability: Using CWE to declare the problem leads to CWE-787. The product writes data past the end, or before the beginning, of the intended buffer.
details.impact: Impacted is confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

cve.summary: A vulnerability has been identified in CPCI85 Central Processing/Communication (All versions < V26.10), SICORE Base system (All versions < V26.10.0). The affected application contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability while parsing specially crafted XML inputs. This could allow an unauthenticated attacker to exploit this issue by sending a malicious XML request, which may cause the service to crash, resulting in a denial-of-service condition.
